text:
[LFCA.5.1] Whether the tier supports declared series with windowed
aggregations.

| Name | Explanation | Depends on | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | a `series` declaration ([LGRA.7]) plus the full aggregation surface (`mean`, `p95`, `stdev`, `direction`, etc.) usable as expression atoms | | the tier has no series subsystem. Restructure to not need windowed aggregation. |

The two capabilities that would write series values through to the samples
plane, `sampled_slots` and `persist_on_series`, are deferred ([LCAP.2.10]).
